# customer-journey-ztna-addon-mockup.png

**Type:** UI wireframe/mockup, screen 10 of the customer journey flow.
**Source context:** `## Customer Journey screen flow`, step 10,
configuring the Zero Trust Network Access add-ons.

Left nav tree shows `Add-ons Subscription` expanded under `SASE`, with
`Zero Trust Network Access` selected and `DNS Security`, `Firewall as a
Service` greyed/not yet reached. Right panel "Zero Trust Network
Access" with two options and a Monthly Recurrent Charge € column:
`Corporate ZTNA` (mandatory, checkbox greyed/checked, €0 per actor a
month) and `Cloud Apps ZTNA` (checked, €1 per actor a month, "up to 35"
field set to `35`, resulting charge `35`, with an `Add` action being
clicked). `OK` (highlighted/clicked) and `Cancel` buttons.
